product.olivetti-m4-133-s.summary: The 133 MHz M4 Modulo on this platform in the Slim Tin Box case.
product.olivetti-m4-133-s.history: Olivetti placed the M4 Modulo in its professional range. This Pentium generation shared a platform with several consumer PCS models. The guide identifies TriGem as the maker of the BA2199 board.
product.olivetti-m4-133-s.architecture: The case sets the expansion capacity. The Slim Tin Box riser offers 1 full-length ISA, one PCI and one shared slot.
product.olivetti-m4-133-s.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-133-s.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-133-s.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 12
product.olivetti-m4-133-s.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.13.
